notes: This file maps current remake runtime heuristics to the original-data exports now available in the repository.
The goal is to separate gaps that are replaceable immediately from gaps still blocked on missing gameplay-table decoding.

runtime.detail: Door rendering still loads a single generic /textures/door.png texture.

originalData.detail: Door families are now extracted: Porticullis, Wooden Door, Iron Door, Ra Door.
Front-door composite strips and front-view door family panels are structurally exported.

runtime.detail: Alcove and sensor-graphic wall decals still fall back to /misc/autel.png or /items/torch_unlit.png.

originalData.detail: Named wall ornaments now include Grate, Empty Torch Holder, Full Torch Holder, Champion Mirror, Lever Up and Lever Down.

domains.name: item_gameplay

runtime.detail: Weapon damage, attack speed, armor values, slot mappings, potion effects and nutrition remain project-maintained.
Reference DB is explicitly marked as derived and not byte-perfect.

originalData.detail: Names and visible identities are strongly recovered.
graphics.dat item 559 documentation now covers global item indexes, categories, attack combos and carry-location bitmasks.

domains.blocker: Companion stat tables for damage, armor, weight and related gameplay values are still not recovered as a structured PC-native dataset.

domains.name: creature_gameplay

runtime.detail: HP, armor, hit probability, speed, XP, attack tags and drop tables remain project-maintained.

originalData.detail: Post-Atari render/layout data is structurally exported.
graphics.dat item 559 creature descriptors are now documented externally, including PC 3.4 variant values and hardcoded exceptions.

domains.blocker: The descriptor data is documented, but has not yet been imported as a structured source-backed runtime dataset.

domains.name: actions_combos_and_training

runtime.detail: Action, combo and training semantics are still largely represented through a derived reference layer rather than a dedicated source-backed dataset.

originalData.detail: Action metadata, combo composition, charge use and minimum skill levels are now documented externally.
Skill relationships, XP rules, level multipliers and growth logic are now documented externally.

domains.blocker: These rules are documented, but not yet normalized into a structured runtime dataset.

domains.name: combat_defense_model

runtime.detail: Creature attack typing exists locally, but the original defense-factor mapping is not yet represented as its own source-backed table.

originalData.detail: The original attack-type to defense-factor model is now documented externally.

domains.blocker: The defense rules are known, but still need explicit integration into the remake combat model.
